lessons.title: TSMC eyes adding facilities in Texas
lessons.title_zh: 台積電著眼於在德州增設廠房

paragraphs.en: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) is considering expanding its chip production to Texas. The company is currently in discussions with a client to secure wafer manufacturing capacity there. This move could extend TSMC's manufacturing presence in the United States beyond its current facilities in Arizona, helping it keep up with the rapidly rising global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) chips.
paragraphs.zh: 台灣積體電路製造公司（台積電，TSMC）正考慮將其晶片生產擴展至德州。該公司目前正與一位客戶進行討論，以確保在當地的晶圓製造產能。這項舉措可能會將台積電在美國的製造版圖延伸至亞利桑那州的現有設施之外，進而幫助其跟上全球對人工智慧（AI）晶片迅速激增的需求。

paragraphs.en: During a recent earnings conference, TSMC chief executive officer C.C. Wei confirmed that the company had sent teams to Texas for evaluations. They are talking with a customer that is constructing a factory called TeraFab to see if TSMC can use that capacity. Wei emphasized that any new facility must follow a strict rule: "the fab [has] got to be run by TSMC." The company believes that ramping up capacity in the US is necessary because major American customers want more local production.
paragraphs.zh: 在最近的一場法人說明會中，台積電執行長魏哲家證實，該公司已派遣團隊前往德州進行評估。他們正與一位正在興建名為 TeraFab 晶圓廠的客戶洽談，以了解台積電是否能夠運用該產能。魏哲家強調，任何新設施都必須遵循一項嚴格的原則：「晶圓廠必須由台積電營運」。該公司認為在美國提升產能是必要的，因為美國主要客戶希望增加在地生產。

paragraphs.en: TSMC remains confident about the future of AI technology, rejecting doubts about the profitability of such large investments. Wei explained that the shift toward AI assistants and open-source models is creating greater need for advanced silicon. At the same time, customer demand continues to exceed what TSMC can supply. In advanced packaging, Wei noted that TSMC's Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate (CoWoS) technology remains the top choice for customers, giving the firm a strong advantage over rivals like Intel Corp.
paragraphs.zh: 台積電對人工智慧技術的未來依舊充滿信心，駁斥了對此類龐大投資獲利能力與永續性的質疑。魏哲家解釋，轉向人工智慧助理與開源模型的趨勢，正對先進矽晶片創造出更大的需求。與此同時，客戶的需求持續遠高於台積電所能供應的產能。在先進封裝方面，魏哲家指出，台積電的基板上晶圓覆晶（CoWoS）技術仍然是客戶的首選，讓該公司在面對英特爾（Intel Corp）等競爭對手時擁有強大的優勢。

paragraphs.en: The chipmaker also shared strong financial forecasts. TSMC expects revenue this quarter to reach between US$52.3 billion and US$54.3 billion, driven by high demand for cutting-edge technologies like its 2-nanometer process. Furthermore, the company reported that net profit last quarter set a new record at NT$763.06 billion. TSMC also plans to build an additional 3-nanometer plant in Tainan, which is scheduled to begin volume production in the first half of 2028.
paragraphs.zh: 這家晶片製造商也分享了強勁的財務預測。由於對其2奈米製程等尖端技術的高度需求推動，台積電預估本季營收將達到523億至543億美元之間。此外，該公司公佈上季淨利達到創紀錄的新台幣7630.6億元。台積電還計劃在台南增建一座3奈米晶圓廠，預計於2028年上半年開始量產。

grammar.point: 現在分詞構句 (Present Participial Construction)
grammar.explain: 在主要子句之後以逗號連接現在分詞片語，用來表示主要子句動作所帶來的結果或伴隨狀況。
grammar.example: This move could extend TSMC's manufacturing presence in the United States beyond its current facilities in Arizona, helping it keep up with the rapidly rising global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) chips.

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 連接詞「if」引導名詞子句，在此當作前面不定詞動詞「see」的受詞，表達「是否」之意。
grammar.example: They are talking with a customer that is constructing a factory called TeraFab to see if TSMC can use that capacity.
grammar.focus: if TSMC can use that capacity

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 在先行詞後使用逗號加上關係代名詞「which」，用來補充說明前面的特定名詞「an additional 3-nanometer plant in Tainan」。
grammar.example: TSMC also plans to build an additional 3-nanometer plant in Tainan, which is scheduled to begin volume production in the first half of 2028.
grammar.focus: which is scheduled to begin volume production in the first half of 2028

lessons.title: Forecasters watch progress of Pacific storm
lessons.title_zh: 氣象預報員密切關注太平洋風暴進展

paragraphs.en: Tropical Storm Champi recently formed in the Pacific Ocean and has the potential to grow stronger. According to the Central Weather Administration (CWA), forecasters are closely watching a Pacific high-pressure system. This atmospheric system will determine whether the tropical storm turns toward the north or moves directly toward Taiwan next week.
paragraphs.zh: 熱帶風暴「薔琵」最近在太平洋生成，且有可能增強。根據交通部中央氣象署（CWA）的說法，預報員正密切觀察一個太平洋高氣壓系統。該大氣系統將決定這場熱帶風暴會在下週北轉，還是直接朝台灣移動。

paragraphs.en: CWA forecaster Cheng Chieh-jen stated that the most likely situation is for the storm to turn northward after moving past the Ryukyu Islands. Official data showed that Champi was located east of Guam, traveling west-northwest at 20 kilometers per hour. It packed maximum sustained winds near its center of 72 kilometers per hour, with wind gusts reaching up to 101 kilometers per hour.
paragraphs.zh: 中央氣象署預報員鄭傑仁表示，最可能的情況是風暴在經過琉球群島後轉向北方。官方資料顯示，薔琵位於關島東方，以每小時二十公里的速度向西北西移動。其中心附近最大持續風速為每小時七十二公里，陣風則高達每小時一百零一公里。

paragraphs.en: Cheng explained that Champi is expected to develop into a moderate typhoon and could become an intense typhoon next week. If the high-pressure system becomes significantly weaker, the storm might turn north earlier. However, if that system strengthens instead, the storm could approach much closer to Taiwan before it makes a turn.
paragraphs.zh: 鄭傑仁解釋，薔琵預計會發展為中度颱風，並可能在下週成為強烈颱風。如果高壓系統明顯減弱，風暴可能會提早北轉。然而，如果該系統反而增強，風暴在轉向之前可能會更接近台灣。

paragraphs.en: Taiwan's local weather will also experience changes in the coming days. Rain is forecast to increase around coastal Keelung, Yilan, Hualien, Taitung, and the Hengchun Peninsula. Furthermore, the arrival of the northeast monsoon or the outer circulation of Champi could bring heavier rainfall to northern and eastern areas by next weekend.
paragraphs.zh: 台灣當地的天氣在未來幾天也將經歷變化。基隆沿海地區、宜蘭、花蓮、台東以及恆春半島預計降雨將會增加。此外，東北季風的抵達或薔琵的外圍環流可能會在下週末前為北部和東部地區帶來更多降雨。

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞 whether 引導的名詞子句，在主要動詞 determine 後面作為受詞，表示「是否……」。
grammar.example: This atmospheric system will determine whether the tropical storm turns toward the north or moves directly toward Taiwan next week.
grammar.focus: whether the tropical storm turns toward the north or moves directly toward Taiwan next week

grammar.point: 條件副詞子句 (Adverbial Clause of Condition)
grammar.explain: 以 if 引導的從屬子句表示假設條件，主要子句則說明在該條件下可能發生的結果。
grammar.example: If the high-pressure system becomes significantly weaker, the storm might turn north earlier.
grammar.focus: If the high-pressure system becomes significantly weaker

grammar.point: 現在分詞片語修飾名詞 (Present Participle Phrase Modifying a Noun)
grammar.explain: 分詞片語 traveling west-northwest... 由現在分詞引導，用來補充修飾前面提到的主詞 Champi 所進行的動作。
grammar.example: Official data showed that Champi was located east of Guam, traveling west-northwest at 20 kilometers per hour.
grammar.focus: traveling west-northwest at 20 kilometers per hour

lessons.title: HPA touts e-cigarette collection rate
lessons.title_zh: 國民健康署宣傳電子煙回收率

paragraphs.en: The Health Promotion Agency (HPA) reported that anonymous e-cigarette disposal points have gathered 633 kilograms since the initiative started on September 8. This amount equals approximately 12,660 devices, assuming each weighs around 50 grams. The agency noted that the six special municipalities account for nearly 70 percent of this total.
paragraphs.zh: 國民健康署（HPA）表示，自9月8日該計畫開始以來，匿名電子煙回收點已收集了633公斤的電子煙。假設每個平均重約50克，這個數量相當於大約12,660個裝置。該署指出，六個直轄市約占總數的70%。

paragraphs.en: To provide safe disposal options, the HPA established 431 collection spots across the country. These locations are mainly situated at local health departments, health bureaus, and public health centers. Meanwhile, the Executive Yuan passed a proposal to add possession to the banned actions, and HPA Tobacco Control Division Director Lo Su-ying explained that the plan is currently under legislative review.
paragraphs.zh: 為了提供安全的棄置選擇，國健署在全國設立了431個回收點。這些地點主要位於當地衛生局、衛生所及公衛中心。同時，行政院通過了一項將「持有」納入禁止行為的提案，國健署菸害防制組組長羅素英說明，該計畫目前正在立法院審議中。

paragraphs.en: Once the revision takes effect, authorities will enforce a one-month grace period where devices are confiscated without fines. Afterward, individuals caught with these products will face penalties ranging from NT$30,000 to NT$100,000. HPA Deputy Director-General Lin Li-ju stated that public support for the program was evident, and services will continue until one month after the legal revisions take effect.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦修法生效，當局將實施一個月的寬限期，在此期間會沒收裝置但不開罰。此後，被抓到持有這些產品的個人將面臨3萬元至10萬元新台幣的罰款。國健署副署長林莉茹表示，公眾對該計畫的支持十分明顯，服務將持續到法規修正生效後一個月。

paragraphs.en: In other developments, the Coast Guard Administration (CGA) dispatched two vessels on a historic diplomatic mission to Palau, reaching Pulo Anna Island for a joint patrol. Additionally, Premier Cho Jung-tai mentioned that the government is monitoring online rumors regarding a potential pneumonic plague outbreak. Furthermore, Taiwan expects to receive 500 Stinger missiles from the United States by the end of the year to strengthen defense capabilities. Finally, Belize and Paraguay recently condemned Beijing sanctions over their diplomatic ties with Taiwan, reaffirming their strong support for democratic values.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他發展方面，海巡署（CGA）派遣兩艘艦艇前往帛琉進行歷史性外交任務，抵達普露安娜島進行聯合巡邏。此外，行政院長卓榮泰提及政府正在監控有關可能爆發肺鼠疫疫情的網路謠言。再者，台灣預計在年底前自美國接收500枚刺針飛彈以強化防衛能力。最後，貝里斯與巴拉圭近日譴責北京因其與台灣的外交關係而實施的制裁，並重申對民主價值的堅定支持。

grammar.point: 過去分詞片語當形容詞 (Past Participle Phrase as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 用過去分詞片語修飾名詞，表示被動或完成的狀態。
grammar.example: These locations are mainly situated at local health departments, health bureaus, and public health centers.

grammar.point: 副詞子句引導詞 (Conjunction of Time)
grammar.explain: 用 once 引導時間副詞子句，表示「一旦……就……」。
grammar.example: Once the revision takes effect, authorities will enforce a one-month grace period where devices are confiscated without fines.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用 to 加原形動詞來表達做某事的目的（為了……）。
grammar.example: To provide safe disposal options, the HPA established 431 collection spots across the country.

lessons.title: Are student protests being manipulated ahead of France's presidential election?
lessons.title_zh: 法國總統大選前夕，學生抗議活動是否正遭到操弄？

paragraphs.en: For more than three weeks, thousands of high school students across France have blocked school gates and marched in the streets. They are speaking out against poor educational conditions and rising social inequality. As new demonstrations spread, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu suggested that political groups are manipulating the students' anger before the upcoming presidential election. He accused the left-wing party France Insoumise (LFI), led by Jean-Luc Mélenchon, of using the teenage movement for electoral gain.
paragraphs.zh: 超過三個星期以來，法國各地數以千計的高中生封鎖了校門並走上街頭遊行。他們公開反對惡劣的教育環境以及日益嚴重的社會不平等。隨著新的示威活動蔓延，法國總理塞巴斯蒂安．勒科爾尼（Sébastien Lecornu）暗示，在即將到來的總統大選之前，政治團體正在操弄學生的憤怒。他指責由讓-呂克．梅朗雄（Jean-Luc Mélenchon）領導的左翼政黨「不屈法國」（LFI），為了選舉利益而利用這場青少年運動。

paragraphs.en: Students report major problems inside their classrooms, including broken walls, overcrowded classes, and a severe shortage of teachers. They feel that French authorities ignore their voices unless they take direct action. Tensions recently escalated after a 15-year-old boy lost a hand because of a stun grenade during a demonstration, prompting the interior minister to suspend the weapon's use. In response, groups of mothers have gathered at school entrances to protect their children and show solidarity with the movement.
paragraphs.zh: 學生們回報了教室內部的嚴重問題，包括牆壁破損、班級人數過多以及師資嚴重匱乏。他們覺得除非採取直接行動，否則法國當局會忽視他們的聲音。最近在一場示威活動中，一名十五歲男孩因震撼彈而失去一隻手，促使內政部長暫停使用該武器，緊張局勢隨之升級。作為回應，許多母親聚集在學校門口，以保護自己的孩子並展現對該運動的支持。

paragraphs.en: Protest has long been an important tradition in France, echoing the famous student demonstrations of May 1968. However, the current unrest is happening during a difficult economic period. France is struggling with high public debt, rising government borrowing costs, and a deeply divided parliament that has seen six prime ministers in five years. While public spending remains very high, citizens feel they are not getting enough quality support from public services.
paragraphs.zh: 抗議長期以來一直是法國的重要傳統，呼應了1968年5月著名的學生示威活動。然而，目前的動盪發生在一個艱困的經濟時期。法國正與高額公共債務、不斷攀升的政府借貸成本，以及一個在五年內經歷了六任總理且嚴重分歧的國會苦苦抗衡。儘管公共支出依然非常高，公民卻覺得自己沒有從公共服務中獲得足夠優質的支援。

paragraphs.en: Politicians and experts offer different solutions to this national crisis. Left-wing leader Mélenchon supports a wealth tax and wants to lower the voting age to sixteen, while right-wing politician Marine Le Pen suggests cutting contributions to the European Union budget. Meanwhile, economist Anne-Laure Delatte believes the country needs constitutional reform. As Delatte noted, "Our Fifth Republic is centred around a powerful president," which makes it hard for a divided parliament to pass laws and solve deep financial problems.
paragraphs.zh: 政治人物和專家對這場國家危機提出了不同的解決方案。左翼領袖梅朗雄支持課徵富人稅，並希望將投票年齡調降至十六歲，而右翼政客瑪琳．雷朋（Marine Le Pen）則建議削減對歐洲聯盟預算的提撥款項。與此同時，經濟學家安-洛爾．德拉特（Anne-Laure Delatte）認為該國需要進行憲政改革。正如德拉特所指出的：「我們的第五共和以一位強大的總統為核心」，這使得一個分裂的國會難以通過法律並解決深層的財政問題。

grammar.point: 過去分詞片語修飾名詞 (Past Participle Phrase Modifying a Noun)
grammar.explain: 由過去分詞「led」開頭的片語置於名詞「France Insoumise (LFI)」之後，作後位修飾，表示被動語意「由……所領導的」。
grammar.example: He accused the left-wing party France Insoumise (LFI), led by Jean-Luc Mélenchon, of using the teenage movement for electoral gain.

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Clause)
grammar.explain: 逗號後面的現在分詞片語「prompting...」作分詞構句，表示前面子句事件所帶來的連帶結果。
grammar.example: Tensions recently escalated after a 15-year-old boy lost a hand because of a stun grenade during a demonstration, prompting the interior minister to suspend the weapon's use.
grammar.focus: prompting the interior minister to suspend the weapon's use

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞「that」在形容詞子句中擔任主詞，修飾前面的先行詞「a deeply divided parliament」。
grammar.example: France is struggling with high public debt, rising government borrowing costs, and a deeply divided parliament that has seen six prime ministers in five years.
grammar.focus: that has seen six prime ministers in five years

lessons.title: Living with a stink? Technology might help
lessons.title_zh: 忍受惡臭生活？科技或許能幫上忙

paragraphs.en: In Milpitas, an affluent city in California, residents have suffered from unpleasant smells for decades because of nearby industrial sites and a huge landfill. Local tech engineer Chia-Ling Kong could not open her windows for ten years. Recently, officials ordered the landfill operators to install monitors and use drones to systematically track odor-causing chemicals.
paragraphs.zh: 在加州富裕城市密爾比達（Milpitas），居民數十年來一直忍受著來自附近工業區和一座龐大垃圾掩埋場的難聞氣味。當地的科技工程師 Chia-Ling Kong 甚至有十年無法打開窗戶。最近，官員已命令該掩埋場的營運單位安裝監測器並使用無人機，有系統地追蹤引發惡臭的化學物質。

paragraphs.en: Communities around the world face similar issues from rubbish dumps, sewage works, and factories. As cities expand through urban sprawl, homes are being built closer to smelly facilities. Resolving these complaints is complicated because many governments lack rules for smells. For instance, the US Environmental Protection Agency does not treat environmental odours as pollutants, leaving local authorities to handle complaints.
paragraphs.zh: 世界各地的社區也面臨著來自垃圾場、污水處理廠與工廠的類似問題。隨著城市透過都市擴張迅速拓展，住宅被蓋在距離散發臭味的設施更近的地方。解決這些投訴相當複雜，因為許多政府缺乏管理異味的規定。舉例來說，美國環境保護局並未將環境氣味視為污染物，使得地方政府必須自行處理投訴。

paragraphs.en: Technology offers several ways to tackle industrial smells, such as absorbing them, changing them chemically, or burning them away. While advanced systems can remove most bad compounds, they are expensive. Some operators choose cheaper methods like spraying large amounts of deodorisers, but experts doubt that these air fresheners can truly solve the problem, especially for massive landfills.
paragraphs.zh: 科技提供了幾種解決工業臭味的方法，例如吸收臭味、透過化學反應轉化臭味，或是將其燃燒消滅。雖然先進的系統可以消除大部分引發臭味的化合物，但成本相當高昂。有些營運商選擇較便宜的方法，例如噴灑大量除臭劑，但專家懷疑這些芳香劑是否真能解決問題，特別是對於廣大的垃圾掩埋場而言。

paragraphs.en: In Des Moines, Iowa, technology has produced promising results. Residents there long suffered from a disgusting smell nicknamed the "Eastside Funk," which was linked to industrial meat companies. To find the culprits, the city installed a ring of monitors paired with a weather station. This system gathers real-time data to pinpoint the exact facility responsible when bad smells spread.
paragraphs.zh: 在愛荷華州第蒙（Des Moines），科技帶來了令人樂觀的成果。那裡的居民長期忍受被暱稱為「東區惡臭」的難聞氣味，這項問題與幾家工業肉品公司有關。為了找出元凶，該市安裝了一圈監測器並搭配氣象站。這個系統收集即時資料，以便在惡臭蔓延時準確指出是哪座設施釀禍。

paragraphs.en: Before installing these electronic devices, officials had to drive to neighborhoods and personally sniff the air. Although electronic noses make detection much more objective, experts note that keeping everyone happy is still difficult because human perception of smell is extremely subjective.
paragraphs.zh: 在安裝這些電子裝置之前，官員必須親自開車前往社區並用鼻子聞空氣。雖然電子鼻讓檢測變得更加客觀，但專家指出要讓每個人都滿意依然很困難，因為人類對氣味的感知極具主觀性。

grammar.point: 現在完成式 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 由「have/has + 過去分詞 (p.p.)」構成，表示過去持續至今的經驗或狀態，常與表示一段時間的介系詞片語連用。
grammar.example: In Milpitas, an affluent city in California, residents have suffered from unpleasant smells for decades because of nearby industrial sites and a huge landfill.

grammar.point: 現在進行式被動語態 (Present Continuous Passive)
grammar.explain: 由「be動詞 + being + 過去分詞 (p.p.)」構成，表達某個動作當前正被動地持續進行。
grammar.example: As cities expand through urban sprawl, homes are being built closer to smelly facilities.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 放在句首的不定詞片語用來說明主要子句動作的目的，意思是「為了……」。
grammar.example: To find the culprits, the city installed a ring of monitors paired with a weather station.

lessons.title: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
lessons.title_zh: 走入伊隆·馬斯克與傑夫·貝佐斯爭奪外太空控制權的競賽

paragraphs.en: The space race used to be a contest between powerful nations like the United States and Russia. Today, however, the competition to explore outer space is mainly fought between two tech billionaires: Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos. Musk leads SpaceX and Starlink, while Bezos founded Amazon and the space company Blue Origin. According to journalist Josh Tyrangiel, both men hope to colonize the moon, mine space resources, and build giant data centers beyond Earth.
paragraphs.zh: 太空競賽過去曾是美國與俄羅斯等強國之間的競爭。然而在今天，探索外太空的競爭主要是在兩位科技億萬富翁之間展開：伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）與傑夫·貝佐斯（Jeff Bezos）。馬斯克領導太空探索科技公司（SpaceX）與星鏈（Starlink），而貝佐斯則創立了亞馬遜（Amazon）與太空公司藍色起源（Blue Origin）。根據記者喬許·泰蘭吉爾（Josh Tyrangiel）的說法，兩人都希望殖民月球、開採太空資源，並在地球之外建造龐大的資料中心。

paragraphs.en: This private race started after the United States government decided to open up space to commercial business in the early 2000s. Officials believed private companies would be faster and cheaper than traditional government programs. While this policy caused space technology to develop rapidly, it also gave a few wealthy individuals immense power. For instance, in 2025, SpaceX launched about eighty percent of all objects sent into orbit, making China its only real rival. Furthermore, Musk controls eleven thousand Starlink satellites, which provide global communications.
paragraphs.zh: 這場民間競賽始於美國政府在2000年代初期決定開放太空進行商業開發之後。官員們認為民間企業會比傳統的政府計畫更快速且成本更低。雖然這項政策促使太空技術迅速發展，但也賦予了少數富有人士巨大的權力。舉例來說，在2025年，SpaceX發射了約百分之八十進入軌道的物體，使中國成為其唯一的真正競爭對手。此外，馬斯克控制著一萬一千顆星鏈衛星，這些衛星提供了全球通訊。

paragraphs.en: Relying on private enterprise creates serious national risks. Experts have warned that the country could find itself at the mercy of unpredictable billionaires. If a private owner decides to cancel flights, the country could lose its ability to reach space independently. For example, during a disagreement with former President Donald Trump, Musk threatened to stop producing rockets for the International Space Station. Without domestic rockets, the United States would have had to pay eighty million dollars to fly an American on a Russian rocket.
paragraphs.zh: 依賴民營企業帶來了嚴重的國家風險。專家曾警告，國家可能會發現自己受制於捉摸不定的億萬富翁。如果一位私人擁有人決定取消飛行班次，該國可能會失去自主進入太空的能力。舉例來說，在一場與前總統唐納·川普（Donald Trump）的分歧期間，馬斯克曾威脅要停止生產前往國際太空站的火箭。如果沒有國內的火箭，美國將不得不支付八千萬美元讓美國人搭乘俄羅斯的火箭飛行。

paragraphs.en: Currently, the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) still directs American space missions under its new administrator, Jared Isaacman. Isaacman has set goals to return astronauts to the moon and pitted the two companies against each other. However, some observers suggest that NASA should make these rivals cooperate instead. For instance, Blue Origin could develop the lunar lander, while SpaceX could supply a large rocket for refueling, allowing the nation to achieve its goals together.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）在新任署長賈里德·艾薩克曼（Jared Isaacman）的領導下，仍然指導著美國的太空任務。艾薩克曼設定了讓太空人重返月球的目標，並使這兩家公司相互競爭。然而，一些觀察家建議NASA應該讓這兩家競爭對手進行合作。例如，藍色起源可以研發登月器，而SpaceX則可以提供用於燃料補給的大型火箭，使國家能夠共同實現其目標。

grammar.point: 動名詞當主詞 (Gerund as Subject)
grammar.explain: 動名詞片語置於句首擔任整句話的主詞，視為單數，因此搭配單數動詞 creates。
grammar.example: Relying on private enterprise creates serious national risks.

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 在先行詞後方加上逗號並使用 which 引導子句，用來對前方的一萬一千顆衛星作補充說明。
grammar.example: Furthermore, Musk controls eleven thousand Starlink satellites, which provide global communications.

grammar.point: 與過去事實相反的假設條件句 (Past Unreal Conditional with Without)
grammar.explain: 介系詞 without 引導與過去事實相反的假設條件，主要子句使用「would have + 過去分詞」表示過去本來會產生的結果。
grammar.example: Without domestic rockets, the United States would have had to pay eighty million dollars to fly an American on a Russian rocket.

lessons.title: How an accelerating Earth led experts to adopt the leap hour
lessons.title_zh: 地球加速自轉如何促使專家採用「閏時」

paragraphs.en: For decades, scientists have worried about the way computers handle time. At a meeting in France, representatives from 69 nations voted to remove the leap second and prepare for a leap hour instead. The International Bureau of Weights and Measures decided this change to protect modern technical networks. When a minute has 61 or 59 seconds, computer software often suffers serious errors.
paragraphs.zh: 幾十年來，科學家一直擔心電腦處理時間的方式。在法國舉行的一場會議上，來自六十九個國家的代表投票決定取消「閏秒」，改為準備實施「閏時」。國際度量衡局做出這項改變是為了保護現代技術網路。當一分鐘有六十一秒或五十九秒時，電腦軟體往往會出現嚴重錯誤。

paragraphs.en: Since 1967, one second has been defined by the steady vibrations of caesium atoms. These atomic clocks provide accurate time for electricity grids, satellites, and communications. However, the rotation of the Earth is not as reliable. Because natural forces such as ocean shifts affect the planet, our world generally spins more slowly than atomic time. To solve this, officials added 27 leap seconds between 1972 and recent years.
paragraphs.zh: 自1967年以來，一秒鐘是根據銫原子穩定的振動來定義的。這些原子鐘為電網、衛星和通訊提供了精確的時間。然而，地球的自轉並沒有那麼可靠。由於海洋移動等自然力量影響著這顆星球，我們的世界自轉速度通常比原子時間慢。為了解決這個問題，官方在1972年至近年之間增加了二十七個閏秒。

paragraphs.en: Recently, the Earth has actually started to spin faster. Scientists saw a 30 percent chance that a negative leap second might be needed soon. This would mean subtracting a second from the official time. In 2012, an extra second caused computer servers to freeze, bringing down websites like Reddit and LinkedIn, and delaying Qantas flights. Experts warned that subtracting a second would carry even greater risks because software has never been tested for it.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，地球實際上開始轉得更快了。科學家發現有百分之三十的機率很快就需要一個負閏秒。這意味著要從官方時間中減去一秒。在2012年，多出的一秒導致電腦伺服器當機，使Reddit和LinkedIn等網站癱瘓，並延誤了澳洲航空的航班。專家警告，減去一秒會帶來更大的風險，因為軟體從未針對這種情況進行過測試。

paragraphs.en: Under the new plan, Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) will be allowed to drift by up to an full hour before any adjustment occurs. A leap hour is not expected to happen for thousands of years. Dr Setnam Shemar, an expert from the UK's National Physical Laboratory (NPL), noted that adding an hour would resemble daylight saving time, which people already know. While some officials pointed out that this vote merely delays the issue for future generations, it successfully shields modern technology from immediate digital chaos.
paragraphs.zh: 在新計畫下，世界協調時間（UTC）將被允許在進行任何調整之前，出現最多達整整一小時的誤差。預計幾千年內都不會發生閏時。來自英國國家物理實驗室（NPL）的專家塞特南·謝馬爾博士指出，增加一小時就像人們已經熟悉的日光節約時間。儘管一些官員指出這次投票只不過是將問題延後給後代處理，但它成功保護了現代科技免於立即陷入數位混亂。

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句中的「to protect」為不定詞片語，用來表示國際度量衡局做出這項決定的目的或原因。
grammar.example: The International Bureau of Weights and Measures decided this change to protect modern technical networks.

grammar.point: 現在完成被動態 (Present Perfect Passive)
grammar.explain: 由「has been」搭配過去分詞「defined」構成，表示從過去持續到現在已被界定的動作狀態。
grammar.example: Since 1967, one second has been defined by the steady vibrations of caesium atoms.

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 逗號後的「which people already know」為非限定關係子句，以關係代名詞「which」補充說明前面的「daylight saving time」。
grammar.example: Dr Setnam Shemar, an expert from the UK's National Physical Laboratory (NPL), noted that adding an hour would resemble daylight saving time, which people already know.

lessons.title: Severe drought declared and hosepipe bans in force - is your area affected?
lessons.title_zh: 嚴重乾旱宣告實施且水管禁令生效——你的地區受到影響了嗎？

paragraphs.en: After months of unusually dry weather, authorities have officially declared a severe drought across several regions in southern England. This classification is the highest drought category and marks the first time it has ever been used since being introduced after the 2012 drought. Most of England and all of Wales were already facing drought conditions after their hottest summer on record, which took a heavy toll on rivers, farmland, and local wildlife.
paragraphs.zh: 在經歷了數個月異常乾燥的天氣之後，當局已正式在英格蘭南部的數個地區宣布「嚴重乾旱」。這個分級是乾旱的最高類別，也是自2012年乾旱後引進該制度以來首次被正式採用。英格蘭大部分地區和威爾斯全境在經歷了有紀錄以來最炎熱的夏季後，早已面臨乾旱狀況，這對河流、農田與當地野生動植物造成了嚴重衝擊。

paragraphs.en: To manage limited water resources, eleven water companies have introduced hosepipe bans, affecting roughly 30 million people across England and Wales. Under these temporary rules, residents cannot use hoses to water gardens, clean vehicles, or fill swimming pools. Meanwhile, environmental officials will step up monitoring of reservoir levels and water quality, while conducting extra inspections on businesses that withdraw water from natural sources.
paragraphs.zh: 為了管理有限的水資源，十一間自來水公司推出了水管禁令，影響了英格蘭和威爾斯約三千萬人。在這些臨時規定下，居民不能使用水管澆灌花園、清洗車輛或注入泳池水。同時，環境官員將加強對水庫水位與水質的監測，並對從自然水源抽取水資源的企業進行額外檢查。

paragraphs.en: A primary reason for this crisis is the sharp drop in reservoir supplies. While England's reservoirs are normally three-quarters full at this time of year, they are now only slightly more than half full on average. River flows have also fallen significantly. Furthermore, underground water levels are declining after the prolonged dry weather. Although groundwater reacts more slowly to weather changes and provides a useful buffer, underground droughts can take much longer to recover.
paragraphs.zh: 造成這場危機的一個主要原因是水庫儲水量的急劇下降。雖然英格蘭的水庫在每年這個時候通常有四分之三滿，但目前平均僅略高於半滿。河流流量也顯著下降。此外，在長期乾旱的天氣之後，地下水位也正在下降。儘管地下水對氣候變化的反應較慢並能提供有用的緩衝，但地下水乾旱一旦發生可能需要更長的時間才能恢復。

paragraphs.en: Droughts are complex events caused by both environmental and human factors. Warmer temperatures increase evaporation, pulling extra moisture from the soil and speeding up dry conditions. However, water companies have also faced criticism for historic underinvestment in water infrastructure. To secure future supplies, companies and the government plan to build nine new reservoirs in England by 2050, alongside another currently under construction in Hampshire. Still, officials warn that repairing leaks and reducing demand are urgently needed.
paragraphs.zh: 乾旱是由環境與人為因素共同造成的複雜現象。較高的氣溫增加了水分蒸發，從土壤中帶走多餘的水分並加速了乾燥狀況。然而，自來水公司也因過去在水利基礎設施上的投資不足而面臨批評。為了確保未來的供水，相關公司與政府計畫在2050年前於英格蘭興建九座新水庫，外加一座目前正在漢普郡（Hampshire）興建的水庫。不過，官員警告，修復漏水與降低用水需求同樣刻不容緩。

grammar.point: 現在完成式 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: have 加上過去分詞 declared 構成現在完成式，表示動作由過去發生並對目前現況產生直接影響。
grammar.example: After months of unusually dry weather, authorities have officially declared a severe drought across several regions in southern England.

grammar.point: 分詞片語修飾主要子句 (Participial Phrase Modifying a Clause)
grammar.explain: 現在分詞片語 affecting... 以逗號隔開接在主要子句之後，用來說明該事件所產生的結果與影響。
grammar.example: To manage limited water resources, eleven water companies have introduced hosepipe bans, affecting roughly 30 million people across England and Wales.
grammar.focus: , affecting roughly 30 million people across England and Wales

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Concession)
grammar.explain: 從屬連接詞 Although 引導讓步子句，表示「雖然……」，與後面的主要子句形成對比。
grammar.example: Although groundwater reacts more slowly to weather changes and provides a useful buffer, underground droughts can take much longer to recover.

lessons.title: £15m for zero-emission testing at Belfast Harbour
lessons.title_zh: 貝爾法斯特港投入一千五百萬英鎊進行零排放測試

paragraphs.en: Belfast Harbour is set to become a real-world testing ground for zero-emission travel and energy systems. This green initiative is supported by a 15-million-pound investment coming from the Local Innovation Partnerships Fund of UK Research and Innovation. A technology group led by Artemis Technologies will link electric boats, powerful marine charging stations, self-driving transport, and energy networks using protected digital twin technology.
paragraphs.zh: 貝爾法斯特港將成為測試零排放交通與能源系統的真實運作環境。這項綠色計畫獲得來自英國研究與創新局（UK Research and Innovation）地方創新夥伴基金的一千五百萬英鎊投資支持。一個由阿提米絲科技（Artemis Technologies）領導的技術團隊，將使用受到保護的數位分身技術，把電動船隻、高功率海上充電站、自駕交通工具以及能源網路連結起來。

paragraphs.en: Researchers plan to test these advanced tools inside an operating port to observe how smoothly they perform together as a single system. In addition, the trial aims to help remove difficulties that usually slow down commercial adoption in the market. Artemis Technologies CEO Dr. Iain Percy stated that their team is developing a digital network designed to manage both transport schedules and power distribution more efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人員計畫在一座運作中的港口內測試這些先進工具，以觀察它們作為單一系統時共同運作得有多順暢。此外，這項試驗旨在協助消除通常會減緩市場商業採納速度的困難。阿提米絲科技執行長伊恩．珀西博士（Dr. Iain Percy）表示，他們的團隊正在開發一個數位網路，旨在更有效率地管理交通時刻表與電力分配。

paragraphs.en: Dr. Percy explained that the smart system will give clear directions to vessels and harbour facilities based on weather conditions. For example, when winds are extremely strong, the network directs boats and the harbour to consume the surplus power. When the wind stops blowing, it instructs them not to use that energy, which prevents wind farms from needing to be shut down and could ultimately lower energy prices for users.
paragraphs.zh: 珀西博士解釋，這個智慧系統將根據天氣狀況向船隻與港口設施發出明確指示。例如，當風勢極為強勁時，該網路會引導船隻和港口消耗過剩的電力。當風力停止時，它會指示它們不要使用該能源，這能防止風力發電廠需要被關閉，並且最終可能為使用者降低能源價格。

paragraphs.en: This project is the second one introduced under a 30-million-pound fund dedicated to the Belfast-Derry Innovation Corridor. Economy Minister Dr. Caoimhe Archibald praised the plan, mentioning that Northern Ireland is world-leading in this field. She added that the project will try to balance energy supply with the heavy demands of the harbour. Officials and researchers hope that the lessons learned here can later be applied to other areas, including Foyle Port and beyond.
paragraphs.zh: 這個專案是專門提供給貝爾法斯特—德里創新走廊（Belfast-Derry Innovation Corridor）的三千萬英鎊撥款中所宣布的第二個計畫。經濟部長曹芙．阿奇博爾德博士（Dr. Caoimhe Archibald）稱讚了這項計畫，提到北愛爾蘭在該領域處於世界領先地位。她補充說，該計畫將努力使能源供應與港口的龐大需求取得平衡。官員與研究人員希望此處學到的經驗未來能應用到其他地區，包括福伊爾港（Foyle Port）及更廣泛的範圍。

lessons.title: GTA 6 - all you need to know about Rockstar's blockbuster game
lessons.title_zh: 《俠盜獵車手 6》——關於 Rockstar 重磅大作你所需要知道的一切

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games has released a new launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI, also known as GTA 6. The trailer confirms that the action-adventure title will officially arrive on November 19. Fans around the world were already able to pre-order the game starting at midnight on June 25. Analysts estimate that development costs have exceeded one billion dollars, which could make it the most expensive video game ever produced.
paragraphs.zh: Rockstar Games 為《俠盜獵車手 6》（GTA 6）發布了全新的上市預告片。該預告片證實，這款動作冒險大作將於 11 月 19 日正式推出。全球粉絲已可從 6 月 25 日午夜開始預購這款遊戲。分析師估計，其開發成本已超過十億美元，這可能使其成為有史以來製作成本最高昂的電玩遊戲。

paragraphs.en: The video introduces the two main protagonists, Lucia and Jason, embarking on a criminal journey together. Lucia will be the very first playable female lead in a 3D environment for the franchise. The story takes place in the fictional state of Leonida, inspired by Florida, and brings back the famous Miami-based Vice City. To accompany the visual showcase, French electronic music duo Justice composed an original song for the score.
paragraphs.zh: 這部影片介紹了兩位主要主角露西亞（Lucia）和傑森（Jason），他們一同展開一場犯罪冒險。露西亞將成為該系列在 3D 環境中首位可供玩家操控的女性主角。故事發生在以佛羅里達州為靈感的虛構州萊昂尼達（Leonida），並讓以邁阿密為原型的著名城市罪惡城（Vice City）回歸。為了配合這段視覺呈現，法國電子音樂組合 Justice 為配樂創作了一首原創歌曲。

paragraphs.en: The release has faced significant hurdles over the years. Originally delayed from autumn 2025 and May 2026, the developer stated that extra time was necessary to achieve high polish. The studio has also encountered cyberattacks from teenage hackers who leaked early footage, as well as recent workplace disputes. Rockstar North, the company headquarters in Edinburgh, faced accusations of union-busting from dismissed workers as developers rushed to finish the project.
paragraphs.zh: 多年來，這次發行面臨了重重阻礙。這款遊戲原先從 2025 年秋季及 2026 年 5 月兩度延期，開發商表示需要額外的時間才能達到高度完善的水準。該工作室還遭遇過少年駭客竊取並外流早期畫面的網路攻擊，以及近期的職場爭議。隨著開發人員趕工完成該專案，位於愛丁堡的公司總部 Rockstar North 遭到了被解僱員工關於破壞工會的指控。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S, costing $79.99 in the United States and £69.99 in the United Kingdom. Physical copies will only contain a digital download code rather than a traditional disc. While the initial release focuses purely on a single-player mode, fans still expect an online component eventually. British gaming entrepreneur Sir Ian Livingstone praised the series, calling it an "incredible achievement in interactive software."
paragraphs.zh: 《俠盜獵車手 6》將於 PlayStation 5 以及 Xbox Series X 和 S 平台上發售，美國售價為 79.99 美元，英國售價為 69.99 英鎊。實體版本將僅包含數位下載代碼，而非傳統光碟。雖然最初發行純粹專注於單人模式，但粉絲們仍預期最終會推出線上組件。英國遊戲企業家伊恩·利文斯通爵士（Sir Ian Livingstone）讚揚了這個系列，稱其為「互動軟體方面的驚人成就」。

lessons.title: Severe drought declared in six areas of England as reservoirs run low
lessons.title_zh: 水庫蓄水量偏低，英格蘭六個地區宣布進入嚴重乾旱

paragraphs.en: A severe drought has been officially declared across six regions of England, including Devon, Cornwall, Dorset, Somerset, East Sussex, and West Sussex. This crisis emerged after the United Kingdom experienced its hottest summer on record. Furthermore, parts of southeastern and southwestern England suffered their driest period between April and September in more than a century, leaving water reserves at dangerously low levels.
paragraphs.zh: 英格蘭的六個地區已正式宣布進入嚴重乾旱，包括德文郡、康瓦爾郡、多瑟特郡、索美塞特郡、東薩塞克斯郡和西薩塞克斯郡。這場危機是在英國經歷了有紀錄以來最炎熱的夏天之後出現的。此外，英格蘭東南部和西南部部分地區經歷了一個多世紀以來最乾燥的四月至九月，使得水資源儲備降至危險的低水平。

paragraphs.en: The shortage has put intense pressure on water storage facilities. While the Environment Agency (EA) normally expects reservoir levels to be around 75 percent at this time of year, some facilities are now nearly empty. For instance, the Ardingly reservoir is only 19 percent full, while the Wimbleball reservoir has dropped to 16 percent. Smaller reservoirs supplying tens of thousands of households in Devon and Cornwall are facing similar difficulties.
paragraphs.zh: 水資源短缺為儲水設施帶來了沉重的壓力。雖然環境署（EA）通常預期每年的這個時期水庫蓄水量應在75%左右，但部分設施目前已幾近乾涸。例如，阿丁利水庫（Ardingly reservoir）的蓄水量僅有19%，而溫布爾鮑爾水庫（Wimbleball reservoir）則已降至16%。為德文郡和康瓦爾郡數萬戶家庭供水的小型水庫也正面臨類似的困境。

paragraphs.en: In response to the emergency, several water companies have asked the government to allow strict limits on non-essential water usage. South East Water, South West Water, and Southern Water want to ban certain activities for businesses, such as golf clubs, private schools, and commercial car washes. However, Environment Secretary Angela Eagle has not yet granted official approval for these measures, though she continues to urge the public to use water wisely.
paragraphs.zh: 為了應對這場緊急情況，數家自來水公司已要求政府允許對非必要用水實施嚴格限制。東南水務公司（South East Water）、西南水務公司（South West Water）和南方水務公司（Southern Water）希望禁止高爾夫俱樂部、私立學校和商業洗車場等企業的特定活動。然而，環境大臣 Angela Eagle 尚未對這些措施給予正式批准，儘管她仍持續呼籲大眾明智用水。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, government officials are preparing for serious environmental impacts. Water Minister Emma Hardy directed the EA to prioritize drinking supplies over environmental regulations when tough choices must be made. The National Drought Group announced that authorities will monitor river levels daily and inspect water quality, as lower water volume reduces sewage dilution. EA Chief Executive Philip Duffy stated, “We cannot change the weather, but water companies can act now.”
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，政府官員正為嚴重的環境衝擊預作準備。水務部長 Emma Hardy 指示環境署在必須做出艱難取捨時，將飲用水供應置於環境法規之上。國家乾旱小組宣布，由於水量減少降低了污水稀釋程度，相關當局將每日監測河流水平並檢查水質。環境署執行長 Philip Duffy 表示：「我們無法改變天氣，但自來水公司現在就可以採取行動。」

lessons.title: Chipmaker sell-off sends investors to other stocks and bonds for safety
lessons.title_zh: 晶片製造商拋售潮促使投資人轉向其他股票與債券以求避險

paragraphs.en: A worldwide drop in semiconductor chip shares pushed investors to seek safer options on Thursday, moving their funds into government bonds and different market sectors. Although computer chip stocks continued their decline for a seventh straight day, other areas provided relief. The Dow and the S&P 500 both gained ground, supported by strong performances in health care, materials, and consumer discretionary shares, while Treasury yields fell sharply as bond prices rose.
paragraphs.zh: 週四半導體晶片股的全球性下跌，促使投資人尋求更安全的選擇，將資金轉移至政府公債與不同的市場板塊。儘管電腦晶片股已連續第七天走跌，其他領域卻帶來了緩解。在醫療保健、原物料以及非必需消費品類股的強勁表現支撐下，道瓊指數與標準普爾500指數雙雙上漲，而隨著債券價格走高，公債殖利率則大幅下滑。

paragraphs.en: The turbulence started after steep losses overnight in Asian manufacturing centers. South Korea’s Kospi plunged 7.6%, which triggered a temporary trading halt after massive drops in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. In Taiwan, technology shares fell after Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) CEO C.C. Wei warned that macroeconomic uncertainty and high component prices were hurting demand in certain market areas, causing TSMC shares to slide 2% despite excellent earnings.
paragraphs.zh: 這場動盪始於亞洲製造中心隔夜的沉重跌勢。南韓綜合股價指數（Kospi）暴跌7.6%，在三星電子與SK海力士大幅重挫後，觸發了暫停交易的熔斷機制。在台灣，台積電（TSMC）總裁魏哲家警告，總體經濟的不確定性以及零組件價格上漲正在打擊某些市場領域的需求，導致台積電股價儘管獲利亮眼仍下跌2%，科技股也隨之走低。

paragraphs.en: Investors are increasingly nervous about the immense costs of building artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure. A strong US inflation report raised concerns that high interest rates will increase borrowing expenses for indebted tech firms. In addition, reports of slower sales growth at top AI developers like Anthropic and OpenAI, along with progress on advanced memory chips by Chinese firm CXMT, added to market anxiety.
paragraphs.zh: 投資人對於建構人工智慧（AI）基礎設施的龐大成本日益感到不安。一份強勁的美國通膨報告引發了疑慮，擔心高利率會增加負債科技公司的借貸費用。此外，有關Anthropic和OpenAI等頂尖AI開發商銷售成長放緩的報導，加上中國企業長鑫存儲（CXMT）在先進記憶體晶片上的進展，更加深了市場的焦慮。

paragraphs.en: Specialized AI cloud providers, known as neoclouds, also faced intense scrutiny. Research firm Gartner predicted that over 80% of these providers will shut down by 2030 because of high operational costs and unproven business models. Meanwhile, CoreWeave, an AI compute provider backed by Nvidia, experienced sharp price swings due to its tens of billions of dollars in debt, though Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expressed optimism about the firm.
paragraphs.zh: 被稱為新興雲端服務商（neoclouds）的專業AI雲端供應商也面臨嚴格檢視。研究機構顧能（Gartner）預測，由於高昂的營運成本以及缺乏獨特的商業模式，超過80%的此類供應商將在2030年前停止營運。與此同時，受到輝達（Nvidia）支持的AI運算供應商CoreWeave因其數百億美元的債務經歷了劇烈的價格波動，儘管輝達執行長黃仁勳對該公司表達了樂觀態度。

paragraphs.en: Despite the rocky week, some analysts believe fears of an AI bubble burst are exaggerated. Jefferies chief European economist Mohit Kumar pointed out that the United States is spending a larger share of its GDP on AI each year than it spent on nineteenth-century railways. He stated that he expects results to show that "earnings and demand remain robust," although political uncertainties and interest rate pressures still create market fluctuations.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管經歷了動盪的一週，一些分析師認為對於AI泡沫破裂的擔憂被過度誇大了。傑富瑞（Jefferies）首席歐洲經濟學家莫希特·庫馬爾（Mohit Kumar）指出，美國每年在AI上的支出占GDP的比例，高於十九世紀在全國興建鐵路的支出。他表示，他預期業績將證明「獲利與需求依然強勁」，儘管政治不確定性和利率壓力仍會引發市場波動。

lessons.title: Factory championing women workers named world’s best new building
lessons.title_zh: 致力於支持女性勞工的工廠獲選為全球最佳新建築

paragraphs.en: A seven-story textile facility in Bangladesh has won the prestigious RIBA International Prize. Organized by the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA), the biennial award honors projects that demonstrate innovative thinking and community value. Green Field Factory, located in the northern city of Rangpur, was commended by the jury as a "work of quiet humility." The building successfully incorporates nature into the workplace through landscaped gardens, green verandas, and a plant-draped wall.
paragraphs.zh: 孟加拉一棟七層樓高的紡織工廠榮獲了聲譽卓著的英國皇家建築師學會國際獎（RIBA International Prize）。該兩年一度的獎項由英國皇家建築師學會（RIBA）主辦，旨在表彰展現創新思維與社群價值的建築計畫。這座座落於北部城市朗布爾（Rangpur）的「綠原工廠」（Green Field Factory），被評審團盛讚為「謙遜沉靜之作」。該建築透過景觀花園、綠意盎然的走廊以及佈滿植物的牆面，成功將大自然融入工作場所。

paragraphs.en: The local firm Nakshabid Architects designed the complex based on traditional Bengali homesteads that feature courtyards and ponds. Most importantly, the project focuses heavily on the wellbeing of its approximately 5,000 employees, who are mostly women. The factory offers special amenities, including a rooftop daycare center, an on-site medical practice, and shady areas to relax. Staff members even bring their families to enjoy these spaces outside of working hours.
paragraphs.zh: 當地的 Nakshabid Architects 建築師事務所借鑑傳統孟加拉農舍庭院與池塘的特色，設計了這座建築園區。最重要的是，這項計畫高度重視其約五千名員工的福祉，其中大多數為女性。該工廠提供了特殊的便利設施，包括屋頂日間托兒中心、廠內醫療診所以及供人放鬆的陰涼休憩區。員工甚至會在工作時間之外，帶著家人一同享受這些空間。

paragraphs.en: This environment stands in sharp contrast to past factory conditions in Bangladesh, a major textile producer. In 2013, the tragic collapse of the Rana Plaza building killed 1,100 people after workers' safety concerns were ignored. Green Field Factory prioritizes safety and challenges deep social hierarchies. For example, instead of keeping separate doorways for different ranks, all employees, managers, and owners share the exact same main entrance.
paragraphs.zh: 這種環境與身為紡織生產大國的孟加拉過去的工廠環境形成了鮮明對比。2013 年，在勞工的安全疑慮遭到忽視後，熱那大廈（Rana Plaza）不幸倒塌，導致一千一百人喪生。「綠原工廠」將安全置於首位，並挑戰了根深蒂固的社會階級制度。例如，工廠並未為不同職級保留分開的出入口，而是讓所有員工、經理與經營者共用同一個主要大門。

paragraphs.en: Operated by Karupannya Rangpur Limited, the factory manufactures textile items such as handmade rugs, doormats, and bathmats. It defeated three other shortlisted finalists, including two Belgian projects and BRAC University in Dhaka. Architect Bayejid M. Khondoker stated that he wanted to prove industry can nurture workers, showing that a factory should be a restorative space rather than a machine that drains human energy.
paragraphs.zh: 該工廠由 Karupannya Rangpur Limited 公司營運，生產手工地毯、門墊與浴室防滑墊等紡織品。它擊敗了另外三件入圍決選的計畫，包括兩件比利時作品以及位於達卡（Dhaka）的布拉克大學（BRAC University）。建築師巴耶吉德．昆多克（Bayejid M. Khondoker）表示，他想證明工業可以培育勞工，展現出工廠應該是一個讓人恢復精力的場所，而不是耗盡人體能量的機器。
