grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞「who」置於逗號之後，用來補充說明先行詞「employees」的相關資訊。
grammar.example: Most importantly, the project focuses heavily on the wellbeing of its approximately 5,000 employees, who are mostly women.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 「to enjoy」為不定詞片語，在句中用來表達員工帶家人前來的目的。
grammar.example: Staff members even bring their families to enjoy these spaces outside of working hours.

lessons.title: Anthropic flags revenue surge to investors ahead of stock market debut
lessons.title_zh: 安索普向投資人揭露營收暴增，迎向股票上市

paragraphs.en: The artificial intelligence giant Anthropic revealed that its revenue grew significantly by forty-five percent to sixteen point eight billion US dollars in the three months leading up to September. These financial details were shared by the Claude-developer during a meeting with prospective investors at its headquarters in San Francisco, as the company prepares for a stock market listing before the year ends.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧巨頭安索普（Anthropic）透露，在截至九月的三個月中，其營收顯著成長了百分之四十五，達到一百六十八億美元。這些財務細節是由這位「克勞德」（Claude）開發商在舊金山總部與潛在投資人會面時分享的，當時該公司正為今年底前的股票上市作準備。

paragraphs.en: This development happens while some technology stocks, including hardware makers that build data center equipment, have experienced drops recently because of worries about huge spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure. Meanwhile, Anthropic stated that it achieved a profit for the second quarter in a row, with quarterly revenue having climbed steadily throughout this year.
paragraphs.zh: 這項發展發生在某些科技股（包括製造資料中心設備的硬體製造商）最近因為擔心人工智慧基礎設施的鉅額支出而下跌之際。同時，安索普表示其連續第二季實現獲利，且本年度的季度營收持續穩步攀升。

paragraphs.en: The financial results from this firm and its rival OpenAI provide an important way to measure the industry growth and its financial capacity to build necessary technology. However, share prices for major chip makers like AMD, Nvidia, and Intel declined sharply. Asian markets also felt the impact, as Japanese investment firm Softbank and South Korean semiconductor giants Samsung and SK Hynix saw their shares drop significantly.
paragraphs.zh: 這家公司及其對手開放人工智慧（OpenAI）的財務結果，提供了衡量產業成長及建立所需技術之財務能力的重要方式。然而，像是超微（AMD）、輝達（Nvidia）和英特爾（Intel）等主要晶片製造商的股價急劇下跌。亞洲市場也感受到衝擊，日本投資公司軟體銀行（Softbank）以及南韓半導體巨頭三星（Samsung）和SK海力士（SK Hynix）的股價都大幅下跌。

paragraphs.en: These market drops followed remarks made by Broadcom chief executive Hock Tan, who stated that many investors have no clue and are acting as if they are in a casino. Additional concerns involve the safety of artificial intelligence models. While OpenAI delayed its public offering to address safety issues, Anthropic has also urged that development should slow down, even as it continues expanding globally by opening a new office in Singapore.
paragraphs.zh: 這些市場跌幅是繼博通（Broadcom）執行長陳福陽（Hock Tan）針對人工智慧支出發表言論之後出現的。陳福陽在新加坡的一場會議上表示，許多投資人毫無頭緒，其設定極端的期望「就像在賭場一樣」。其他擔憂則涉及人工智慧模型的安全性。當開放人工智慧延遲其公開上市以解決安全問題時，安索普也敦促應放慢開發速度，儘管它仍透過在新加坡開設新辦事處來繼續全球擴張。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 使用關係代名詞子句補充說明硬體製造商。
grammar.example: This development happens while some technology stocks, including hardware makers that build data center equipment, have experienced drops recently because of worries about huge spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 使用被動語態表達財務細節是由開發商分享的。
grammar.example: These financial details were shared by the Claude-developer during a meeting with prospective investors at its headquarters in San Francisco, as the company prepares for a stock market listing before the year ends.

lessons.title: Make a 'sick day' kit for cold and flu season before your household gets hit
lessons.title_zh: 在家中有人生病前，為感冒與流感季節準備一個「生病護理包」

paragraphs.en: Cold and flu season in the United States runs from October through May, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Colder temperatures and dry air make people more susceptible to illnesses like colds, the flu, RSV, or COVID-19. Pediatrician Mona Amin and pharmacist Alisha Reed recommend preparing a "sick day kit" in advance so that family members do not have to rush to a pharmacy while sick.
paragraphs.zh: 根據疾病管制與預防中心的資料，美國的感冒與流感季節從十月一直持續到五月。較低的氣溫與乾燥的空氣使人們更容易感染感冒、流感、呼吸道融合病毒（RSV）或 COVID-19 等疾病。兒科醫師 Mona Amin 和藥師 Alisha Reed 建議提前準備一個「生病護理包」，如此一來家庭成員在生病時就不必匆忙趕去藥局。

paragraphs.en: Many viral infections cannot be treated with antibiotics, so managing symptoms at home is essential. Reed advises choosing medications that target specific symptoms rather than multi-symptom drugs, which can lead to accidental overmedication. Essential supplies include fever reducers such as acetaminophen, pain relievers, antihistamines for runny noses, and decongestants to open airways. A cough suppressant helps calm dry coughs, while staying hydrated acts as a natural expectorant for chest congestion.
paragraphs.zh: 許多病毒感染無法用抗生素治療，因此在家中控制症狀至關重要。Reed 建議選擇針對特定症狀的藥物，而非可能導致意外用藥過度的多合一症狀藥物。必備用品包括乙醯胺酚等退燒藥、止痛藥、治療流鼻水的抗組織胺，以及暢通呼吸道的去充血劑。止咳劑有助於平息乾咳，而保持水分充足則能作為胸部化痰的天然祛痰劑。

paragraphs.en: Helpful non-medicinal remedies and tools should also be included in the box. A thermometer is crucial for checking body temperature, while saline nasal sprays help keep nasal passages moist and loosen mucus. For cough relief, honey is effective for soothing the throat, but it must never be given to infants under twelve months because of the risk of botulism.
paragraphs.zh: 有助益的非藥物療法與工具也應包含在盒子裡。體溫計對於檢查體溫至關重要，而生理食鹽水鼻噴劑則有助於保持鼻腔濕潤並稀釋黏液。在緩解咳嗽方面，蜂蜜能有效舒緩喉嚨，但由於肉毒桿菌中毒的風險，絕對不能給十二個月以下的嬰兒食用。

paragraphs.en: Other useful items include a cool-mist humidifier, chest rubs used with caution, disposable vomit bags, and drinks like juice or water to prevent dehydration. While basic preventative measures like handwashing and vaccines help, Reed notes that "no prevention strategy is foolproof." When symptoms do not improve or serious warning signs appear, patients should contact a doctor immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 其他有用的物品包括冷霧加濕器、謹慎使用的胸部舒緩膏、拋棄式嘔吐袋，以及果汁或水等可預防脫水的飲料。雖然勤洗手和接種疫苗等基本預防措施有所幫助，但 Reed 指出「沒有任何預防策略是萬無一失的」。當症狀沒有改善或出現嚴重的警告徵兆時，病患應立即聯繫醫師。

vocab.zh: 極其重要的；不可或缺的

grammar.point: 目的副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞「so that」引導目的子句，表示「以便於……」或「為了……」，說明前述準備護理包的目的。
grammar.example: Pediatrician Mona Amin and pharmacist Alisha Reed recommend preparing a "sick day kit" in advance so that family members do not have to rush to a pharmacy while sick.
grammar.focus: so that family members do not have to rush

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 由「助動詞 cannot + 原形 be + 過去分詞 treated」構成被動語態，表示病毒感染「無法被治療」。
grammar.example: Many viral infections cannot be treated with antibiotics, so managing symptoms at home is essential.

grammar.point: 時間副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Time)
grammar.explain: 由從屬連接詞「When」引導時間副詞子句，說明主要子句「聯絡醫生」應發生的時機。
grammar.example: When symptoms do not improve or serious warning signs appear, patients should contact a doctor immediately.
grammar.focus: When symptoms do not improve or serious warning signs appear

lessons.title: ‘Like selling wolves from Yellowstone’: how protected US sharks are being sold off to foreign aquariums
lessons.title_zh: 「宛如販賣黃石公園的狼」：受保護的美國鯊魚如何被賣給外國水族館

paragraphs.en: In Delaware Bay on the eastern coast of the United States, sand tiger sharks find a safe habitat. Although these sharks have sharp, jagged teeth, they are actually calm animals with very low birth rates. In most parts of the world, their numbers have dropped dramatically because of overfishing. However, strict American fishing laws have helped protect them in local waters, where ordinary anglers are forbidden to keep them.
paragraphs.zh: 在美國東海岸的德拉瓦灣（Delaware Bay），沙虎鯊找到了安全的棲息地。雖然這些鯊魚擁有鋒利且參差不齊的牙齒，但牠們實際上是性情溫和且繁殖率極低的動物。在世界上大部分地區，牠們的數量由於過度捕撈而急劇下降。然而，美國嚴格的捕魚法規有助於在當地水域保護牠們，一般的垂釣者被禁止將牠們捕撈帶走。

paragraphs.en: Despite these protections, private businesses are using a legal process to capture these protected animals and sell them to foreign aquariums. A recent study by marine scientists revealed that eighty sand tiger sharks were taken from Delaware Bay between 2018 and 2024. Most of these sharks were shipped to facilities in countries such as China and the United Arab Emirates. Collections increased rapidly from only two sharks in 2018 to forty in 2023.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有這些保護措施，私人企業卻利用合法程序捕捉這些受保護的動物，並將牠們賣給外國水族館。海洋科學家最近的一項研究顯示，在 2018 年至 2024 年間，有八十隻沙虎鯊從德拉瓦灣被帶走。這些鯊魚大部分被運往中國和阿拉伯聯合大公國等國家的設施。捕獲數量迅速增加，從 2018 年的僅兩隻上升到 2023 年的四十隻。

paragraphs.en: To catch these sharks legally, companies must get federal approval from NOAA Fisheries and state permits from Delaware officials. One company based in Florida, Dynasty Marine, caught seventy-one sand tiger sharks between 2022 and 2024. The firm stated that it follows all regulations and that displaying marine animals helps educate the public about ocean conservation.
paragraphs.zh: 為了合法捕獲這些鯊魚，公司必須獲得美國國家海洋漁業局（NOAA Fisheries）的聯邦許可，以及德拉瓦州官員核發的州許可證。一家總部位於佛羅里達州的公司「皇朝海洋」（Dynasty Marine），在 2022 年至 2024 年間捕獲了七十一隻沙虎鯊。該公司表示，他們完全遵守所有法規，且展示海洋動物有助於就海洋保育教育大眾。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, researchers are worried because the local shark population has never had a formal scientific assessment. Removing large, near-adult sharks could harm their ability to reproduce. Brad Wetherbee, a shark researcher who co-wrote the study, criticized the practice, stating that it was “like going into Yellowstone and catching wolves” to sell overseas. Scientists argue that private companies should not profit from animals that the public worked hard to protect.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管如此，研究人員仍然感到擔憂，因為當地的鯊魚族群從未進行過正式的科學評估。帶走大型且接近成年的鯊魚可能會損害牠們的繁殖能力。共同撰寫該研究的鯊魚研究員布拉德·韋瑟比（Brad Wetherbee）批評了這種做法，表示這「宛如走進黃石公園抓狼」賣到海外。科學家主張，大眾努力保護的動物，不應讓私人企業從中獲利。

grammar.point: 過去式被動語態 (Past Simple Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 由「were + 過去分詞（taken）」構成，表示主詞「沙虎鯊」在過去被人類帶走捕捉的被動事實。
grammar.example: A recent study by marine scientists revealed that eighty sand tiger sharks were taken from Delaware Bay between 2018 and 2024.

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 置於句首的「To + 原形動詞」片語，用來說明主要子句動作的目的（為了合法捕獲這些鯊魚）。
grammar.example: To catch these sharks legally, companies must get federal approval from NOAA Fisheries and state permits from Delaware officials.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 who 作為子句中的主詞，修飾先行詞「a shark researcher」，補充說明該專家的背景。
grammar.example: Brad Wetherbee, a shark researcher who co-wrote the study, criticized the practice, stating that it was “like going into Yellowstone and catching wolves” to sell overseas.

lessons.title: Wales has a school standards crisis. Will plans to fix it actually work?
lessons.title_zh: 威爾斯正面臨學校標準危機。解決它的計畫真的會成功嗎？

paragraphs.en: A brand new school complex recently opened in Wales, but this positive development comes at a difficult time. According to the Programme for International Student Assessment (Pisa), a global testing system that measures teenager skills in reading, maths, and science, Wales ranked the worst among United Kingdom nations. This result has shocked many educators and parents, especially as secondary school application deadlines approach. The data reveals that Welsh fifteen-year-olds are roughly two years behind students in England in major subjects, prompting serious questions about why the regional education system is lagging.
paragraphs.zh: 威爾斯最近啟用了一座嶄新的學校複合體，但這項正面的發展卻出現在一個艱難的時刻。根據評估青少年閱讀、數學和科學能力的全球考試系統「國際學生能力評量計畫」（Pisa），威爾斯在英國各國中排名墊底。這個結果震驚了許多教育工作者和家長，特別是在中學入學申請截止日期逼近之際。資料顯示，威爾斯十五歲學生的表現大約落後英格蘭學生兩個學年，這引發了關於為何該地區教育系統落後的嚴肅質疑。

paragraphs.en: Education in Wales has been managed by the devolved administration since nineteen ninety-nine. Over the years, leaders have made major changes, such as removing league tables and standardized tests to try a different approach from England. However, poor test results in two thousand and ten led to a return of accountability measures, including annual reading and maths tests. Later, these policies changed again as officials focused on developing a completely new curriculum, which some experts now view as a major distraction from core academic standards.
paragraphs.zh: 威爾斯的教育自一九九九年起由地方自治政府管理。多年來，領導階層做出了重大改變，例如取消排行榜與標準化測驗，試圖採用與英格蘭不同的方法。然而，二〇一〇年不佳的考試成績導致問責措施重新回歸，包括每年一次的閱讀與數學測驗。隨後，隨著官員們將焦點轉向開發全新的課程，這些政策再次改變，有些專家現在認為這分流了對核心學術標準的注意力。

paragraphs.en: Some international education experts argue that weak accountability is the main reason for the poor rankings. While England introduced structured phonics and clear directions for teachers, Wales chose to give schools complete freedom to design their own curricula. Critics explain that this lack of clear guidance creates wide inconsistencies between schools and can harm disadvantaged pupils the most. Teachers who are already dealing with tight budgets and student behavior issues have struggled under this heavy responsibility.
paragraphs.zh: 一些國際教育專家主張，薄弱的問責制是排名不佳的主要原因。英格蘭引入了結構化的自然發音法與給老師的明確指示，而威爾斯則選擇賦予學校完全的自由來設計自己的課程。批評者解釋說，缺乏明確指引會在學校之間造成巨大的不一致，並且對弱勢學生的傷害最大。已經在應付吃緊的預算與學生行為問題的教師，在這個沉重的責任下掙扎。

paragraphs.en: Beyond teaching methods and curriculum design, structural issues within local government may also play a role. Unlike England, Wales has no academies, and education is run by twenty-two local councils. Former leaders admit that having so many small councils makes it difficult to provide the right level of guidance and challenge. As officials and educators reflect on these challenges, everyone agrees that finding effective ways to support teachers and students is essential before the next global tests take place.
paragraphs.zh: 除了教學方法與課程設計之外，地方政府內部的結構性問題可能也扮演了一定的角色。與英格蘭不同，威爾斯沒有獨立學校，教育是由二十二個地方委員會營運。前領導人坦言，擁有這麼多小型委員會使得提供適當水準的指導與挑戰變得困難。當官員與教育工作者反思這些挑戰時，大家都同意在下次全球考試舉行之前，找到支援老師與學生的有效方法是至關重要的。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞子句 (Relative clause)
grammar.explain: 用來修飾前方名詞 Pisa 的形容詞子句，補充說明該測驗系統的功能。
grammar.example: According to the Programme for International Student Assessment (Pisa), a global testing system that measures teenager skills in reading, maths, and science, Wales ranked the worst among United Kingdom nations.
grammar.focus: that measures teenager skills in reading, maths, and science

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive voice)
grammar.explain: 表示教育由地方自治政府所管理，主體承受動作。
grammar.example: Education in Wales has been managed by the devolved administration since nineteen ninety-nine.

grammar.point: 不定詞片語作副詞用表目的 (Infinitive of purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表達嘗試不同方法的目的。
grammar.example: Over the years, leaders have made major changes, such as removing league tables and standardized tests to try a different approach from England.
grammar.focus: to try a different approach from England

lessons.title: For the future of green politics, look beyond the Green party | Zoe Williams
lessons.title_zh: 為了綠色政治的未來，請跳脫綠黨的思考框架

paragraphs.en: Climate politics recently faced a significant challenge in the United Kingdom when a Reform UK councillor attempted to scrap a climate emergency declaration in King’s Lynn and West Norfolk. Although the motion was eventually voted down, similar debates are happening across the country. Some populist politicians continue to argue that reducing carbon emissions is too expensive or unnecessary. They claim that net zero goals are merely a luxury belief held by a comfortable elite who ignore the daily struggles of ordinary people.
paragraphs.zh: 氣候政治最近在英國面臨了一項重大挑戰，當時一位英國改革黨（Reform UK）的市議員試圖在金斯林與西諾福克（King’s Lynn and West Norfolk）廢除氣候緊急狀態宣言。儘管該動議最終遭到否決，類似的辯論仍在全國各地上演。一些民粹主義政治人物持續主張，減少碳排放過於昂貴或不必要。他們宣稱，淨零目標只不過是安逸菁英階層所持有的奢侈信仰，這些人忽視了普通百姓的日常掙扎。

paragraphs.en: Many people across the UK actually want action on climate change, but turning this strong public feeling into concrete political progress remains difficult. Rightwing populists exploit economic anxieties, such as the rising cost of living, to build support for their views. They frame climate policies as an unfair burden on the masses. When governments fail to address these deep financial worries, they inadvertently strengthen the appeal of populist arguments, leaving many citizens feeling hopeless about the future.
paragraphs.zh: 英國許多民眾實際上希望採取行動應對氣候變遷，但要將這種強烈的公眾感受轉化為具體的政治進展仍然很困難。右翼民粹主義者利用經濟焦慮（例如不斷上升的生活成本）來為他們的觀點建立支持。他們將氣候政策描繪成對大眾的不公負擔。當政府未能解決這些深層的財務擔憂時，他們無意間強化了民粹主義論點的吸引力，讓許多公民對未來感到絕望。

paragraphs.en: To counter this trend, green politicians like Caroline Lucas and philosopher Rupert Read propose a strategy called eco-popularism. This approach focuses on promoting practical actions that genuinely improve people's lives rather than relying purely on emotional appeals or abstract global warnings. By demonstrating how green policies can lower energy costs and build community resilience, leaders can counter the misleading narratives spread by populists and inspire genuine public support.
paragraphs.zh: 為了對抗這種趨勢，像卡羅琳·盧卡斯（Caroline Lucas）這樣的綠黨政治人物與哲學家魯珀特·里德（Rupert Read）提出了一項名為「生態大眾主義」（eco-popularism）的策略。這種方法著重於推動能真正改善人民生活的實際行動，而不是純粹依賴情感訴求或抽象的全球警告。透過展示綠色政策如何降低能源成本並建立社區韌性，領導人可以反擊民粹主義者散播的誤導性敘事，並激發真正的公眾支持。

paragraphs.en: Ultimately, defeating climate skepticism requires local unity and clear communication from all political parties. Leaders must show that they have a reliable plan for cheaper energy, food security, and extreme weather events. If mainstream politicians fail to offer a hopeful and coherent alternative, they will continue to lose ground to opponents who offer simple but destructive answers to complex global problems.
paragraphs.zh: 最終，擊敗氣候懷疑論需要所有政黨的地方團結與清晰溝通。領導人必須證明他們針對更便宜的能源、糧食安全以及極端氣候事件制定了可靠的計畫。如果主流政治人物無法提供充滿希望且一致的替代方案，他們將繼續在面對複雜全球問題時，將陣地輸給那些提供簡單卻具破壞性答案的對手。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 用所引導的子句來修飾先行詞，補充說明普通百姓的處境。
grammar.example: They claim that net zero goals are merely a luxury belief held by a comfortable elite who ignore the daily struggles of ordinary people.
grammar.focus: who ignore the daily struggles of ordinary people

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 使用 be 動詞加上過去分詞來強調動作的承受者，此處指動議被投票否決。
grammar.example: Although the motion was eventually voted down, similar debates are happening across the country.

lessons.title: Hands-on with the Ocarina of Time remake, the most ornate Zelda game ever made
lessons.title_zh: 實測《時之笛》重製版：史上最華麗的薩爾達傳說遊戲

paragraphs.en: Following the huge success of several movie projects, Nintendo is preparing to bring The Legend of Zelda to the big screen next April. To keep the franchise popular, the company is lavishly remaking its classic 1998 video game, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. The title is scheduled to debut on November fifth.
paragraphs.zh: 繼幾個電影計畫獲得巨大成功之後，任天堂（Nintendo）準備在明年四月將《薩爾達傳說》（The Legend of Zelda）搬上大銀幕。為了維持這個系列的熱度，該公司正砸重金重製其 1998 年的經典電玩遊戲《薩爾達傳說：時之笛》（The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time）。該作品預定於 11 月 5 日正式登場。

paragraphs.en: The new version stands out by offering a family-friendly fantasy world, arriving just two weeks before the massive release of Grand Theft Auto VI. While the competition features extreme realism and violent themes, the Zelda remake maintains the cartoony aesthetic of the original game while adding incredible detail. Characters wear hand-stitched fabrics and leathers, and creatures feature complex textures.
paragraphs.zh: 新版本透過提供老少咸宜的奇幻世界脫穎而出，並在《俠盜獵車手 VI》（Grand Theft Auto VI）大型發行前兩週推出。雖然競爭對手主打極致的寫實主義與暴力主題，但這款薩爾達重製版在加入不可思議細節的同時，仍保留了原作卡通化的美學。角色穿著手工縫製的織物與皮革，生物則呈現出複雜的質感。

paragraphs.en: During a preview event, a player explored areas like Kokiri Forest and Hyrule Field, noting that clever lighting makes the world feel surprisingly vast. Castle Town also appears much busier, filled with banners and flowers. However, the rich visual details can sometimes overwhelm the eye, making it slightly difficult to navigate through complex dungeons without missing important items.
paragraphs.zh: 在預覽活動期間，一名玩家探索了科奇利森林（Kokiri Forest）與海拉爾平原（Hyrule Field）等區域，並指出巧妙的燈光讓世界感覺大得驚人。城堡鎮（Castle Town）也顯得更加熱鬧，充滿了旗幟與花朵。然而，豐富的視覺細節有時會讓人應接不暇，在沒有漏掉重要道具的情況下，要穿越複雜的地城會變得稍微困難。

paragraphs.en: Regarding mechanical updates, Nintendo kept changes relatively modest. The developer added a user interface similar to recent series entries and introduced a quest log in the menu. Furthermore, players can now use a manual jump and a button to sprint, which helps them move quickly across the linear adventure without constantly rolling around.
paragraphs.zh: 在機制更新方面，任天堂保持了相對保守的做法。開發商加入了類似近期系列作品的使用者介面，並在選單中引入了任務日誌。此外，玩家現在可以使用手動跳躍以及衝刺按鈕，這有助於他們在這趟線性冒險中快速移動，而不必一直翻滾。

paragraphs.en: With the movie debut approaching, this remake is seen as a smart choice to attract both longtime fans and new players. The high production values reflect Nintendo's new priority of giving careful attention to both animation and gameplay, though players will need more than a short session to fully judge the deep quality of the experience.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著電影上映日期的逼近，這款重製版被視為吸引老粉絲與新玩家的明智選擇。高製作水準反映了任天堂的新優先事項，也就是對動畫與遊戲玩法都給予細心的關注，儘管玩家需要超過一場短暫的體驗才能完全評判其深層品質。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞子句 (Relative clause)
grammar.explain: 說明用來修飾前方名詞「items」的形容詞子句結構。
grammar.example: making it slightly difficult to navigate through complex dungeons without missing important items.

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participial clause)
grammar.explain: 說明由逗號隔開、沒有連接詞且以現在分詞開頭的附帶狀況子句。
grammar.example: Castle Town also appears much busier, filled with banners and flowers.

lessons.title: Defiance or denial? Inside Manchester City’s bubble, decked with inflatable bananas
lessons.title_zh: 反叛還是否認？曼城泡泡裡充斥著充氣香蕉

paragraphs.en: Manchester City recently played against Paris Saint-Germain at the Etihad Stadium while facing major controversy. The Premier League club has been found guilty of over one hundred financial breaches and has received harsh criticism. However, the club continues to maintain its innocence and insists it is the victim of unfair treatment.
paragraphs.zh: 曼徹斯特城足球俱樂部最近在伊蒂哈德球場對陣巴黎聖日耳曼，同時面臨重大爭議。這家英格蘭超級聯賽俱樂部被判定違反了一百多項財務規定，並受到嚴厲批評。然而，該俱樂部繼續堅稱自己清白，並堅持認為自己是不公平對待的受害者。

paragraphs.en: Inside the stadium, the atmosphere felt entirely detached from the external trouble. Manager Enzo Maresca and the players have publicly stayed united behind the club ownership. Supporters also embraced their new reputation as villains, filling the stands with optimism and hundreds of yellow inflatable bananas as a historical callback to the 1980s.
paragraphs.zh: 在球場內，這種氣氛讓人感覺完全脫離了外部的麻煩。總教練恩佐·馬雷斯卡和球員們公開團結在俱樂部所有權背後。支持者也接受了他們作為反派的新形象，用樂觀情緒和數百個黃色充氣香蕉填滿了看台，作為對1980年代歷史的回顧。

paragraphs.en: During the match, Paris Saint-Germain was supported by their manager Luis Enrique, who expressed hope that Manchester City would avoid severe penalties. Meanwhile, former manager Pep Guardiola returned to the stadium to show strong support for unity. Despite a four to two defeat, the club and its fans maintained a cheerful appearance.
paragraphs.zh: 比賽期間，巴黎聖日耳曼得到了他們的總教練路易斯·恩rique的支持，他表達了希望曼徹斯特城能避免嚴厲處罰的願望。同時，前總教練佩普·瓜迪奧拉重返球場，對團結表現出強烈支持。儘管以四比二落敗，該俱樂部及其球迷仍保持著歡快的表象。

paragraphs.en: Once people step outside the stadium, reality quickly returns. Fans mostly refuse to discuss the legal charges and simply tell reporters to wait for the appeal. Experts note that as long as the appeal process continues, the club will continue to face serious tests during every upcoming league match.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦人們走出球場，現實很快就會回歸。球迷大多拒絕討論法律指控，只是告訴記者等待上訴。專家指出，只要上訴程序繼續進行，該俱樂部將在每一場即將到來的聯賽中繼續面臨嚴峻考驗。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 此句使用被動語態「has been found」來表達俱樂部被判定違規的事實，強調受動者。
grammar.example: The Premier League club has been found guilty of over one hundred financial breaches and has received harsh criticism.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 此句使用關係代名詞「who」引導形容詞子句，用來修飾巴黎聖日耳曼的總教練路易斯·恩rique。
grammar.example: During the match, Paris Saint-Germain was supported by their manager Luis Enrique, who expressed hope that Manchester City would avoid severe penalties.
grammar.focus: who expressed hope that Manchester City would avoid severe penalties

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 此句使用不定詞片語「to show strong support for unity」來表達前總教練重返球場的目的。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, former manager Pep Guardiola returned to the stadium to show strong support for unity.
grammar.focus: to show strong support for unity

lessons.title: OpenAI accuses former employee of leaking intel on AI device to Apple
lessons.title_zh: OpenAI指控前員工洩漏AI設備機密給蘋果

paragraphs.en: OpenAI has accused an unnamed former employee of stealing sensitive intellectual property about an unreleased gadget and sharing some details with Apple. According to a court document filed on Wednesday, the individual worked briefly for OpenAI for six months after leaving Apple, and then returned to Apple.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧公司OpenAI指控一名未具名的前員工，竊取有關一款尚未發布之裝置的敏感智慧財產權，並將部分細節分享給蘋果（Apple）。根據週三提交的一份法院文件，該名個人在離開蘋果後，曾在OpenAI短暫工作了六個月，隨後又返回蘋果任職。

paragraphs.en: The filing states that the worker downloaded over one hundred highly confidential files to personal storage before going back to Apple. These transferred documents allegedly included detailed pictures of the upcoming hardware along with secret engineering and manufacturing information. The final download reportedly happened in June on the worker's last day at the company.
paragraphs.zh: 該文件指出，該名員工在返回蘋果之前，將一百多份高度機密檔案下載到個人儲存空間中。據稱這些被轉移的文件包含了即將推出的硬體之詳細圖片，以及機密的工程與製造資訊。據報導，最後一次下載發生在六月份該員工在該公司的最後一天。

paragraphs.en: OpenAI further claimed that this former employee made a presentation regarding product plans to senior leaders at Apple, including an Asian operations vice president. The filing suggests that Apple is now using this gathered knowledge to push forward into the market for smart products powered by artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI進一步聲稱，這名前員工曾向蘋果的高階主管們（包含一位亞洲營運副總裁）進行有關產品計畫的簡報。該文件暗示，蘋果現在正利用這些收集到的知識，大力推動進入由人工智慧驅動的智慧產品市場。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Apple told CNN that it found no evidence supporting these claims and follows strict rules to prevent new hires from using past confidential materials. Apple also mentioned it would cooperate with OpenAI to remove any found information from its systems. Furthermore, Apple stated that the accusations are simply an attempt to create a distraction from an ongoing legal case brought by Apple in July.
paragraphs.zh: 同時，蘋果告訴美國有線電視新聞網（CNN），他們未發現任何證據來支持這些指控，並且遵守嚴格的規定以防止新進員工使用過去的機密資料。蘋果也提到，將會與OpenAI合作，從其系統中移除任何被發現的資訊。此外，蘋果表示這些指控純粹是試圖轉移焦點，以掩飾蘋果在七月所提起的一起進行中的法律訴訟。

paragraphs.en: In that previous lawsuit, Apple claimed that former staff members who moved to OpenAI downloaded confidential files and encouraged candidates to bring parts to job interviews. OpenAI denied those earlier claims, stating that Apple failed to identify any stolen trade secrets and tried to have the case dismissed. Both tech giants are currently competing intensely to develop new smart devices, while Silicon Valley continues to see a high rate of engineers moving between companies.
paragraphs.zh: 在該起先前的訴訟中，蘋果聲稱跳槽至OpenAI的前員工下載了機密檔案，並鼓勵應徵者將零件帶到工作面試中。OpenAI否認了那些早期的指控，表示蘋果未能識別出任何被竊取的營業秘密，並試圖駁回此案。兩大科技巨頭目前正激烈競合作開發新的智慧裝置，同時矽谷也持續看到工程師在公司之間流動的高比率。

grammar.point: 現在完成式 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 用來表示過去發生的動作對現在造成的影響或持續的狀態。
grammar.example: OpenAI has accused an unnamed former employee of stealing sensitive intellectual property about an unreleased gadget and sharing some details with Apple.

grammar.point: 現在分詞當形容詞 (Present Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 使用 V-ing 修飾前面的名詞，表達主動或進行的概念。
grammar.example: Both tech giants are currently competing intensely to develop new smart devices, while Silicon Valley continues to see a high rate of engineers moving between companies.

lessons.title: The fight between the SEC and LSU isn’t over and the Tigers still could be kicked out of the conference
lessons.title_zh: SEC與LSU之間的爭鬥尚未結束，這支老虎隊仍有可能被踢出聯盟

paragraphs.en: The Southeastern Conference (SEC) has filed a response in a federal lawsuit against Louisiana State University (LSU) to keep a legal dispute alive. The league claims that the university continues to break professional rules by trying to add players with professional draft backgrounds to its roster.
paragraphs.zh: 東南聯盟（SEC）已針對對路易斯安那州立大學（LSU）提起的聯邦訴訟提交回應，以維持此法律爭端。該聯盟宣稱，該大學持續透過試圖將具備職業選秀背景的球員納入名單來違反職業規則。

paragraphs.en: This conflict started when LSU men's basketball coach Will Wade recruited players who had professional basketball involvement. This action is in direct conflict with the conference policy which states that athletes who have declared for professional drafts without properly withdrawing cannot compete.
paragraphs.zh: 此衝突始於LSU男子籃球隊教練威爾·韋德（Will Wade）招募了曾參與職業籃球的球員。此舉直接與聯盟政策衝突，該政策規定曾宣佈參加職業選秀且未正確退出的運動員不得參賽。

paragraphs.en: The players involved include R.J. Luis, Saliou Niang, and Brice Dessert, who have experienced different degrees of NBA participation. Although Luis signed professional contracts, he won a court injunction to play, but the coach later stated that Luis was not on the roster and the school would follow conference protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 涉事的球員包含R.J. 路易斯（R.J. Luis）、薩利烏·尼安（Saliou Niang）及布里斯·德塞特（Brice Dessert），他們都有過不同程度的NBA參與經歷。儘管路易斯簽過職業合約並贏得法院禁令得以出賽，但教練隨後表示路易斯並未列入名單，且學校將遵循聯盟規範。

paragraphs.en: However, the coach feels positive about other players such as Niang, who was drafted and played in Summer League games. SEC commissioner Greg Sankey has avoided commenting directly on these individual players, stating that they will let the legal filing speak for itself.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，該教練對其他球員感到樂觀，例如曾在選秀會中被選中並打過夏季聯賽的尼安。SEC主席格雷格·桑基（Greg Sankey）則避免直接評論這些個別球員，表示將讓法律文件說明一切。

paragraphs.en: Although expelling the school is unlikely because the university is a major source of revenue, the league recently approved a strict discipline policy for schools that roster professional players. The penalties could include a half-season suspension for a coach and severe fines.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管將該校除名不太可能，因為該大學是主要的營收來源，但聯盟最近批准了一項針對將職業球員列入名單學校的嚴格紀律政策。處罰可能包含教練半季禁賽以及重罰。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 用來表示主詞接受動作的狀態，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞 drafted。
grammar.example: However, the coach feels positive about other players such as Niang, who was drafted and played in Summer League games.

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表達做出某個動作的目的，在此說明學校持續這樣做的意圖。
grammar.example: The league claims that the university continues to break professional rules by trying to add players with professional draft backgrounds to its roster.

lessons.title: World’s oldest shipwreck found off coast of Turkey
lessons.title_zh: 土耳其海岸外發現世界上最古老的沉船

paragraphs.en: Archaeologists exploring the waters off the southern coast of Turkey have discovered an ancient shipwreck. The vessel dates back roughly 4,700 years, which makes it the oldest known shipwreck in the world. According to an official statement from Turkey's culture ministry, the wreck lies at a depth of about 100 feet near Kekova Island.
paragraphs.zh: 在土耳其南部海岸外水域進行探勘的考古學家發現了一艘古代沉船。這艘船的歷史大約可追溯至4,700年前，使其成為世界上已知最古老的沉船。根據土耳其文化部發布的官方聲明，這處殘骸位於凱科瓦島（Kekova Island）附近約100英尺深的水下。

paragraphs.en: During the underwater excavations, researchers brought up several ancient storage jars called amphorae. These clay containers, created between 4,400 and 4,700 years ago, offer valuable clues about ancient seafaring life and commercial routes. While sailors primarily used such vessels to carry wine or olive oil, one particular container has special markings and two holes. Experts believe this unique pot might have served to make cheese or butter, suggesting that sailors perhaps kept live goats on board for fresh dairy products.
paragraphs.zh: 在水下挖掘過程中，研究人員打撈起數個被稱為雙耳細頸瓶（amphorae）的古代儲藏罐。這些製於4,400至4,700年前的陶製容器，為古代航海生活和商業路線提供了寶貴的線索。雖然水手主要使用這類容器來運送葡萄酒或橄欖油，但其中一個容器具有特殊的標記和兩個孔洞。專家認為這個獨特的罐子可能曾被用來製作乳酪或奶油，這顯示水手或許曾在船上飼養活山羊以獲取新鮮乳製品。

paragraphs.en: Professor Hakan Öniz from Akdeniz University first found the site four years ago. At that time, researchers thought the jars were from a much later period. However, Öniz noticed that they closely matched ancient jars uncovered near the Giza pyramids in Egypt. He then arranged a follow-up dive and invited Australian archaeologist Karin Sowada to inspect the site. Öniz said the team are "generally confident" that this is the world's oldest wreck, noting that discovered anchors and other items also belong to the same era.
paragraphs.zh: 來自阿克代尼茲大學（Akdeniz University）的哈坎·歐尼茲（Hakan Öniz）教授在四年前首次發現了這個遺址。當時，研究人員認為這些罐子來自更近期的時代。然而，歐尼茲注意到它們與埃及吉薩金字塔附近出土的古老罐子高度相似。隨後，他安排了一次後續潛水，並邀請澳洲考古學家卡琳·索瓦達（Karin Sowada）視察該遺址。歐尼茲表示，團隊「普遍確信」（generally confident）這是世界上最古老的沉船，並指出發現的船錨和其他文物也都屬於同一個時代。

paragraphs.en: Turkey’s culture and tourism minister, Mehmet Nuri Ersoy, revealed that tests on the clay point to workshops in the Jordan Valley as the origin of these jars. Similar pottery has appeared in Egypt, Troy, and Crete. This evidence highlights the vital sea routes that linked distant regions. Historians suspect the unfortunate ship was traveling from the Levantine coast toward Troy or Crete when it sank.
paragraphs.zh: 土耳其文化和旅遊部長穆罕默德·努里·埃爾索伊（Mehmet Nuri Ersoy）透露，對陶土的分析指出約旦河谷（Jordan Valley）的工坊是這些罐子的產地來源。類似的陶器也曾出現在埃及、特洛伊（Troy）和克里特島（Crete）。這項證據凸顯了連接遙遠地區的重要海上航線。歷史學家推測，這艘不幸的船隻在沉沒時，可能正從黎凡特海岸航行前往特洛伊或克里特島。

grammar.point: 非限定關係代名詞 (Non-defining Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 逗號後的「which」作為非限定關係代名詞，用來代替前面整件事（沉船歷史可追溯至4,700年前），並引出其造成的結果。
grammar.example: The vessel dates back roughly 4,700 years, which makes it the oldest known shipwreck in the world.
grammar.focus: , which makes it the oldest known shipwreck in the world

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 逗號後使用現在分詞「suggesting」構成的分詞構句，省略了連接詞，用來補充說明主句所衍生出的推測或結果。
grammar.example: Experts believe this unique pot might have served to make cheese or butter, suggesting that sailors perhaps kept live goats on board for fresh dairy products.
grammar.focus: , suggesting that sailors perhaps kept live goats on board for fresh dairy products

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 「to inspect the site」為不定詞片語，在此句中作副詞使用，用來清楚說明邀請澳洲考古學家前來的「目的」。
grammar.example: He then arranged a follow-up dive and invited Australian archaeologist Karin Sowada to inspect the site.

lessons.title: Philadelphia Eagles fans flock to the bar that brings the City of Brotherly Love to London
lessons.title_zh: 費城老鷹隊球迷湧入將「兄弟愛之城」帶到倫敦的酒吧

paragraphs.en: When JP Teti moved from South Philadelphia to London, he noticed a lack of regional American cuisine and traditional dive bars. He decided to leave his corporate job and create a unique place that served authentic local food and offered a true cultural experience.
paragraphs.zh: 當 JP Teti 從南費城搬到倫敦時，他注意到當地缺乏美國地方美食和傳統平價酒吧。他決定辭去企業工作，打造一個供應道地地方美食並提供真實文化體驗的獨特場所。

paragraphs.en: After years of selling food from a truck and perfecting recipes, Teti opened the first Passyunk Avenue in Fitzrovia in 2018. That same year, the Philadelphia Eagles won the Super Bowl and brought the trophy to the original venue, helping the business grow to five locations in London.
paragraphs.zh: 經過多年從餐車販售食物和精進食譜，Teti 於 2018 年在菲特茲羅維亞開設了第一家 Passyunk 大道酒吧。同一年，費城老鷹隊贏得超級盃並將獎盃帶到最初的店面，助推該企業在倫敦發展到五個據點。

paragraphs.en: As a large number of football fans traveled to London recently, they flocked to the bars to enjoy familiar foods like cheesesteaks and participate in events. The venues successfully created a lively atmosphere that made visitors feel completely at home.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著大量美式足球球迷最近前往倫敦，他們湧入這些酒吧享用起司牛排等熟悉的食物並參加活動。這些場所成功營造出熱鬧的氣氛，讓遊客感到完全就像在家一樣。

paragraphs.en: Reflecting on his journey, Teti expressed deep satisfaction with how his business brought people together. He noted that Passyunk Avenue now serves as an outpost of hope and cultural exchange for those who appreciate American traditions.
paragraphs.zh: 回顧自己的旅程，Teti 對他的事業如何將人們聚集在一起表達了深深的滿足感。他指出，對於那些欣賞美國傳統的人來說，Passyunk 大道現在成了希望與文化交流的前哨站。

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participial Construction)
grammar.explain: 用現在分詞片語作為附加的補充說明，省略連接詞且主詞與主要子句相同。
grammar.example: Reflecting on his journey, Teti expressed deep satisfaction with how his business brought people together.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 使用 who 引導形容詞子句，用來修飾先行詞 those。
grammar.example: He noted that Passyunk Avenue now serves as an outpost of hope and cultural exchange for those who appreciate American traditions.

grammar.point: 目的不定詞 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用不定詞片語來表達動作的目的，說明為什麼要做這個動作。
grammar.example: He decided to leave his corporate job and create a unique place that served authentic local food and offered a true cultural experience.
grammar.focus: to leave his corporate job and create a unique place

lessons.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs
lessons.title_zh: 這些工人正在幫助訓練有一天可能會搶走他們工作的機器人

paragraphs.en: In Karur, India, some factory workers have discovered that they are wearing smart glasses and headsets to record their daily tasks. The video footage of their hand gestures is collected to train artificial intelligence robots to take over human jobs. Many employees were not informed about this purpose before wearing the devices, raising serious concerns about labor exploitation.
paragraphs.zh: 在印度卡魯爾，一些工廠工人發現自己正戴著智慧眼鏡與頭戴式裝置來記錄日常工作。他們手部動作的影片畫面被收集起來，用以訓練人工智慧機器人來接管人類的工作。許多員工在佩戴這些裝置之前並未被告知此目的，這引發了對勞動力剝削的嚴重擔憂。

paragraphs.en: India has become a major place for gathering this egocentric data because of its large population and relatively low wages. Experts explain that today's AI systems function like brains without bodies, so they need real human movements to learn intricate physical skills. While some companies pay workers by the hour for this recording process, other laborers are simply made to work while filmed without any explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 由於龐大的人口與相對低廉的薪資，印度已成為收集這種第一人稱視角資料的主要地點。專家解釋，現今的人工智慧系統運作起來就像沒有身體的大腦，因此牠們需要真實的人類動作來學習複雜的身體技能。雖然有些公司按時計費向工人支付錄製過程的費用，但其他勞工卻只是在不知情的狀況下，一邊工作一邊遭到拍攝。

paragraphs.en: Although experts envision a future full of automated machines, the deployment of such technology in India might take a long time. High costs and unreliable power supplies across parts of the country make running robots much more expensive than employing humans. Nevertheless, local tech companies continue to gather both egocentric and exocentric data for domestic and foreign clients who need help with difficult or repetitive tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管專家們預想了一個充滿自動化機器的未來，但此類技術在印度的部署可能需要很長時間。該國部分地區的高昂成本與不穩定的電力供應，使得運行機器人的花費遠高於雇用人類。然而，當地科技公司仍繼續為需要困難或重複性任務協助的國內外客戶，收集第一人稱與第三人稱視角的資料。

paragraphs.en: Inside these tech facilities, employees record themselves folding clothes, washing dishes, and sorting objects using special tools. Workers are paid a small hourly wage to repeat these domestic and industrial chores so that machines can learn various shapes and sizes. Some laborers feel that the work is tiring, but they also realize that their current tasks will eventually be done by robots.
paragraphs.zh: 在這些科技設施內部，員工使用特殊工具錄製自己摺衣服、洗碗以及分類物品的過程。工人們獲得微薄的時薪來重複這些家務與工業雜務，好讓機器能夠學習各種形狀與尺寸。有些勞工覺得這項工作很疲累，但也意識到他們目前的工作最終將由機器人來完成。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, some textile workers who wear these recording headsets have mixed feelings about the situation. One factory employee mentioned that she is proud to teach the robots how to perform quality checks and package items properly. When machines eventually replace her job in the future, she plans to switch to farming and raise cattle to support her family.
paragraphs.zh: 同時，一些佩戴這些錄影頭戴式裝置的紡織工人對這種情況有著複雜的感受。一名工廠員工提到，她為能教導機器人如何進行品質檢查與正確包裝物品感到驕傲。當機器未來最終取代她的工作時，她計劃轉行當農夫並飼養牲畜來養家糊口。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive voice)
grammar.explain: 表達主體「被」收集的動作，強調承受動作的對象。
grammar.example: The video footage of their hand gestures is collected to train artificial intelligence robots to take over human jobs.

grammar.point: 表目的的不定詞 (Infinitive of purpose)
grammar.explain: 用不定詞片語來表示做某事的目的（為了訓練……）。
grammar.example: The video footage of their hand gestures is collected to train artificial intelligence robots to take over human jobs.
grammar.focus: to train artificial intelligence robots to take over human jobs

lessons.title: Stop making sense: focus on sounds to help learn a language, study suggests
lessons.title_zh: 別死背文法：研究指出聚焦聲音有助於學習語言

paragraphs.en: A recent study suggests that if individuals want to master a foreign language like French, Arabic, or Hungarian, they should focus on pronunciation instead of starting with rote learning for vocabulary and grammar. Researchers from University College London (UCL) and Tohoku University in Japan discovered that the brains of the most talented language learners actually process foreign terms as random noise rather than recognizable words.
paragraphs.zh: 一項最新研究顯示，如果個人想要精通法語、阿拉伯語或匈牙利語等外語，應該聚焦於發音，而不是從死背單字和文法開始。來自倫敦大學學院（UCL）與日本東北大學的研究人員發現，最具語言天份的學習者的頭腦，實際上是將外國詞彙視為隨機噪音，而不是可辨識的單字。

paragraphs.en: Normally, people try to understand a new language through the sounds of their native tongue, which can make foreign pronunciation much harder to learn. To find out why top linguists can overcome this challenge, the researchers compared the auditory precision of 67 Japanese learners of English. They measured how well participants could detect slight changes in pitch, length, and tone using non-speech sounds.
paragraphs.zh: 通常人們會透過母語的聲音來理解新語言，這會使得外國發音更難學習。為了找出頂尖語言學家為何能克服這項挑戰，研究人員比較了 67 位學習英語的日本學習者的聽覺精確度。他們使用非語音聲音，測量參與者辨別音高、長度和音調微小變化的能力。

paragraphs.en: The results showed that learners with higher auditory precision mastered new pronunciations much faster and more accurately. Their brain activity patterns were closer to those found when processing non-speech sounds, relying less on the brain's left sensorimotor system for language processing. Professor Kazuya Saito-van Poeteren from the UCL Institute of Education stated, "I do not think British people are biologically bad at languages."
paragraphs.zh: 結果顯示，具有較高聽覺精確度的學習者能更快且更準確地掌握新發音。他們的腦部活動模式較接近處理非語音聲音時的情形，較少依賴大腦用於語言處理的左側感覺運動系統。來自倫敦大學學院教育研究所的齊藤凡波特倫（Kazuya Saito-van Poeteren）教授表示：「我不認為英國人在生物學上不擅長語言。」

paragraphs.en: The researchers explained that many people receive too little meaningful exposure combined with ineffective teaching methods. Learners with high auditory precision can make effective use of sparse input, while others might need much more exposure. Therefore, schools should develop learners' ear for language in line with their auditory characteristics rather than just relying on traditional practice methods.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人員解釋，許多人接受到的有意義接觸太少，再加上教學方法沒有效率。具有高聽覺精確度的學習者能有效利用稀疏的輸入，而其他人則可能需要更多的接觸。因此，學校應該順應學習者的聽覺特徵來培養他們對語言的敏銳度，而不是只依賴傳統的練習方法。

grammar.point: 目的不定詞 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」置於句首或句中，用來表達某個動作的目的（回答為什麼）。
grammar.example: To find out why top linguists can overcome this challenge, the researchers compared the auditory precision of 67 Japanese learners of English.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞子句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 使用關係代名詞 which 引導形容詞子句，用來修飾並補充說明前面的名詞 sounds。
grammar.example: They measured how well participants could detect slight changes in pitch, length, and tone using non-speech sounds.

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 由「be動詞 + 過去分詞」構成，強調承受動作的主體，且主詞為被動接受。
grammar.example: The results showed that learners with higher auditory precision mastered new pronunciations much faster and more accurately.
